resource_policy.execution_order: per shape: admitted one-epoch fit → post-fit assertions → full-valid prediction → fold-0 grade → postgrade assertions before next fit; one production B16 inference resource profile precedes the first full-valid export
resource_policy.note: bandit_resources owns host/CPU/GPU lock admission. Root independently checks current aggregate committed memory and actual observed VRAM before every GPU step; its controller does not enforce the 5 GB observed ceiling automatically. The initial 5 GB fit reservation follows the live H256x2 fit admission and 4.45 GB host peak; root rechecks each larger shape.

launch_gate.profile: R2 actual train_rnn CLI B8/C2000 FP32 H256x2 one-batch finite-update profile passed; before first full-valid export, an actual production-predictor B16 first-batch resource profile is required.
launch_gate.budget: One matched B8/C2000 FP32 epoch, fixed terminal epoch 0, 14,920 optimizer updates and 11,936 sequence exposures per shape. This is an architecture screen, not a saturation conclusion.
launch_gate.precondition: No shape is selected on fit-time or profile quality; all eight complete before later seeds/folds or architecture-selection claims.
